title: Nested aggregate re-emission made fresh-calibration proof selection ambiguous

reproduction.observed: The exact C24 calibration passed 36 planned TaskNodes, all 113 environment batches, and qualification.full, but proof materialization found two valid same-identity static.full objects because qualification.full re-emitted its aggregate dependency.

root_cause.summary: Complete-MIRCPAggregateGate always emitted aggregate dependencies again when closing a parent aggregate, while New-MIRCPFreshCalibrationProof searched the complete evidence store instead of resolving the one exact TaskNode object selected by the final qualification execution manifest.

regression_propositions: repeating one exact aggregate closure retains one current TaskNode result
ordinary and aggregate evidence ambiguity fails closed
fresh-calibration proof selection follows the exact final qualification manifest object digest
unselected valid history cannot override the final qualification manifest closure
duplicate TaskNode identities inside the final manifest fail closed
the immutable pre-repair C24 context is not reinterpreted by repaired controller code
C24, P9, and C30 package bytes remain unchanged

closure.proof_required: one complete fresh C24 calibration and compact manifest-bound proof under the repaired committed controller; the pre-repair green context remains immutable readiness evidence only
